query:
Someone in the group mentioned that Dev had recently helped them set up a piece of tech — something that had been misbehaving since Tuesday. Who was that person?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Claire
C. Marcus
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Dev, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T10:57:00) good result. my offer to check the party wall still stands if he has any noise issues the other way too
[2] (about=Yuki, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:00:00) He'd probably appreciate that. He mentioned the boiler makes a sound like someone crying at 3am.
[3] (about=Dev, core, t0 @2025-10-12T10:14:00) Offered to check Marcus's doorbell after the parcel help, around 3pm.
[4] (about=Dev, core, t10 @2025-11-23T10:36:00) Will try but no promises.
[5] (about=Marcus, said_by=Dev, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T11:10:00) Dev offers to help load a van for the move.
[6] (about=Sandra, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:48:00) That sounds about right for Marcus. I'm glad you were there, Dev. -- Sandra
agent_answer: Marcus (C). Dev offered to check Marcus's doorbell after helping with the parcel — the doorbell being the piece of tech that had been misbehaving.
